'''Vampyres''' are monsters which may be found fighting for [[Zamorak]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They are slightly stronger than their [[Feral vampyre|Morytanian counterparts]], and also susceptible to [[Silver weapons|silver]] and [[blisterwood]] weapons that feral vampyres have. If the player is wearing a [[holy symbol]] whilst being attacked by a vampyre, occasionally the vampyre will be debuffed, reducing their Attack, Strength, Defence, and Magic by 25%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/650998169736753152|date=5 October 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98468|archivedate=13 May 2023|quote=It reduces the vampire's strength, attack, defence and magic by 25%.}} This is indicated by the chatbox message "The vampyre is weakened by your holy symbol of saradomin", which is hidden by the spam filter.
